item.title: Queer ‘rapbrarian’ Roy Kinsey talks hip-hop, dandelions and representation
item.description: Have you heard of the “Rapbrary?” For those who haven’t, it’s the brainchild of Roy Kinsey, who developed the one-of-a-kind library to preserve rap and hip-hop as culturally significant literary art forms, foster creativity, preserve marginalized voices and fight censorship, among other things. item.title: SAVOR Brewery closing, queer pitmaster’s series, musician’s restaurant pick
item.description: End of the line: Teatro ZinZanni announced that its current Chicago show will conclude on Jan. 31.
